newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-MOST STOCKS MOVE HIGHER ON NERVOUS MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-MOST STOCKS MOVE HIGHER ON NERVOUS MARKET.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse on
Monday was nervous with very moderate turnover although buying
pressure took most stocks higher, dealers said.
The Talse increased by 1.18 percent to close on 251.76 with
46.8 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
Total market equity capitalisation reached 13.69 billion
kroons compared to Friday's 13.61 billion kroons.
The most active stock was Uhispank with 16.8 million kroons
of shares traded. The stock was 1.40 kroons higher with a close
on 56.75 kroons.
"Investors could have been responding to the news of the new
board for Uhispbank but it is difficult to say what the local
investors were responding to," one trader said.
Hansapank saw trade of 11 million kroons of shares to end
3.50 kroons higher on 256.50 kroons.
"There wass a general expectation in the press that most
shares would rise this week and this seems to be winning over
those who wanted to sell," a dealer said.
Hoiupank saw trade of 9.5 million kroon of shares
to pick up 0.90 kroons for a close on 126.45 kroons.
On the over-the-counter market, total trade was 15.5 million
kroons of shares with diversified industrialist Norma
the most traded stock.
Norma turned over seven million kroons of shares to be
stable on 74.75.
"There were some sellers about, but there was enough
interest to support the price," another trader said.
